subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella remain canonical until Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention lands, or should maintainers close it in favor of the narrower native Anthropic replay issue now that the recovery-carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: Current main fixed two recovery carriers, but the remaining prevention path changes provider replay behavior and has multiple open candidate PRs with compatibility tradeoffs that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a maintainer-approved prevention PR lands or the remaining variants are explicitly split.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its active fix PR.

options.title: Accept Recovery-Only Scope
options.body: Declare the recovery fixes sufficient and defer prevention policy to later provider replay work, accepting possible one-shot 400 recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a maintainer-approved prevention PR lands or the remaining variants are explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the recovery discussion and appears in the merged recovery history, making him the best available routing owner from the likely-owner set.
